versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- Updated model configuration in SKILL.md: changed model from "u1-insuremed" to "u2-med".
- No other user-facing changes.

Initial release of med-pharma-clinical-trial-statistics:

- Provides statistical analysis support for pharmaceutical clinical trial data, focusing on descriptive statistics and group comparisons.
- Supports multiple input formats: JSON, CSV, Excel, text, PDF, and images (with OCR).
- Outputs structured JSON and AI-generated Markdown analysis for easy integration.
- Quick start and minimal input examples included for user reference.
- Compatible with Python 3.7+ and requires an appkey for API-based model inference.
